    Automorphisms of star models #

    Proof of Proposition 4.1, Step 4 (periodic-mesh-calculations.tex): "For D and E, root the tree at the trivalent vertex; for odd A, root it at its middle vertex. Every tree automorphism fixes that root."

    • With three arms, every automorphism fixes the centre (fixes_centre_three).
    • For a path (one arm), an automorphism is the identity or the reversal of depths (path_aut); a reversal preserving the parity of depths fixes the middle vertex.
    source

    y = y'

    A neighbour of an arm vertex has depth one less or one more, and is determined by its depth.
